messages:
Raj (Content): Draft of tri-mode landing copy (hosted/dedicated/private) up in GDrive — quick gut check plz? Big sync tomorrow 10am. https://drive.google.com/abc
Tess (Growth): Saw it. Overall good. Concern: hero headline feels generic. Suggest: "Run LLMs with predictable latency, cost, and control" :thinking_face:
Maria (Marketing): Love it. Can we shorten Hosted blurb to 2 lines? People skim. :point_up:
Leo (Design): Putting variant with condensed hero in Figma now — will push before lunch.
Eli (Product): Important: tie benchmarking narrative to concrete metrics — e.g., "~10ms/token at p95 on smallest hosted config" and cost per 1k tokens. PMs want numbers, not vagaries.
Raj (Content): Agree. Will add a benchmark callout. @Eli can you confirm p95/p99 numbers for hosted vs dedicated?
Eli (Product): Assigning to infra: @ops-bot can we surface p95/p99 perf for hosted vs dedicated on a sample doc?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3245 and attached perf CSV. https://redwood/internal/INF-3245
Maria (Marketing): For Private, we need security microcopy: "VPC, KMS, and on‑prem options for regulated data." Keep it short and in one line.
Tess (Growth): Also map lead routing: Hosted => self-serve; Dedicated => sales-qualified; Private => enterprise SDR. I'll draft GTM rules.
Tess (Growth): ```
route_map = {
  "hosted": "self-serve",
  "dedicated": "sales-qualified",
  "private": "enterprise-sdr"
}
```
Raj (Content): Perfect. Also planning a short webinar: "Choosing the right deployment: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private" — can we seed the page with a CTA to register? Maria to own landing CTA.
Maria (Marketing): I can own. Draft CTA copy: "Compare deployment options — join the webinar" and secondary link "See benchmarks".
Leo (Design): :thumbsup: layout looks good. One note: mobile hero stack should prioritize "cost" then "control" for scannability.
Eli (Product): We should A/B test two hero CTAs (register vs benchmark). Adding to the experiments board.
Raj (Content): Thanks — I'll push an update to the doc before EOD. Quick thumbs if no objections.
Tess (Growth): :thumbsup:
Maria (Marketing): :thumbsup:
